decisions.reason: Redoing and resubmitting the eight clips does not change the existing requirement that all eight clips use one YouTube video or the other source-selection rules.
The task-local instruction to redo the eight trial clips does not alter the persistent target of 180 approved clips per month.
The source reiterates the existing lesson-oriented moment standard and reports its failure in the submitted batch; it does not change the requirement value.

The source's visual-style change is already represented by the same-message MODIFY adding animations and flashy transitions to the prohibited treatments; the batch-redo decision requires no additional modification.
The source does not change or discuss the hook-selection criterion.
The complete, standalone narrative standard is already captured by a same-message MODIFY; redoing the batch adds no further value or scope change.
The switch to white text with no text effects is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The redo instruction does not modify the existing 20-to-120-second duration range.
The exact-brand-font standard is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, so the batch-redo decision requires no additional event.
